en: The front of the postcard displays a black and white photograph of a rural, hilly landscape featuring a valley, forested areas, and fields. In the foreground, two children can be seen, with one flying a kite. There is a cluster of houses in the background. The text 'Pyrmont' is printed in the upper left and 'Blick nach Friedenstal vom Königsberg' in the upper right. The back of the card has handwritten German text, a green postage stamp from the German Empire ('Deutsches Reich'), and a museum stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'. It is addressed to a Fräulein Marg B. in Braunschweig.
